decision_scope: Native Blender authored-master motion study and Colab portability only; full production gate remains open.
summary: A self-contained authored Blender master produced a 15-second local EEVEE video and three Cycles/CUDA poses in Colab using the identical master hash. The simplified draft differs from the supplied illustration. This proves bounded saved-file rendering, not automatic reference reconstruction, approved TABI likeness, hard actions or an app-driven monthly workflow.

likeness.evidence: Supplied illustration and earlier generated reference compared directly with eight actual Blender views. Simplified facial surface/eyes, flat gills, garment detail and faceted tail differ. No approved reproduction claimed.

frills_and_anatomy.evidence: Six rigid gills stay attached to the same head across 360 frames; all conservative bounds stay in camera. Head/collar bounds overlap and one pair of arms are regression checks, not proof of anatomically correct surfaces. User visual review remains open.

breathing_and_head_turn.evidence: Continuous breathing, three blinks and a small head turn are rendered in the 15-second study. Thirty sampled video frames were visually reviewed; full decode and all-frame geometry checks passed. The turn is not a qualified window gaze, and temporal artistic acceptance is pending.

walking.evidence: Baked object-transform hierarchy is not a general skinned walking rig. No walking authored or tested.

train_and_cafe_reuse.evidence: One native train study with independent scenery movement. No cafe variant or second complete scene video.

different_garment.evidence: One authored green coat. Material recolouring is not proof of a genuinely different garment.

cup_contact.evidence: Cup remains static on the table; hand-to-cup and mouth contact are not tested.

deep_breath.evidence: Larger inhale/hold/exhale rendered near the end and at cloud frame 295. Visible chest displacement recorded; visual approval and 90-second action schedule remain open.

light_and_dark_motion.evidence: Eight transparent stills were reviewed over light/dark backgrounds. A motion comparison over both backgrounds was not rendered.

restart_reuse.evidence: Saved hash-identical master was reopened with autoexec disabled by local render/audit processes and cloud Blender. No complete second video after restart or app-driven reuse rehearsal.

production_rehearsal.evidence: Only 15 seconds at 960x540 and three diagnostic cloud frames; no finished 90-second 1080p video or 30-video monthly benchmark.

automation.evidence: Codex authored Blender geometry, hierarchy and baked motion with Python and corrected setup defects. The user did not sculpt or rig, but one-time authored setup and new-asset work are not automatic reconstruction. No video-story preparation UI integration.

commercial_rights.evidence: Blender licence permits commercial use of original output and does not apply GPL to the rendered artwork. New Blender API scripts use GPL-3.0-or-later. No external model weights or paid add-ons. Underlying reference rights and final publication approval remain separate and unasserted.

user_visual_review.evidence: New native study and comparison delivered for user review; no visual approval received.

operations: Read existing P01 plan and actual supplied references; preserved all previous candidates and preferred 90-second video.

Authored native meshes/materials, train scene, six attached gills, one arm pair, static cup and baked breathing/blink/turn/sway/deep-breath transforms. Corrected parenting scale loss, camera cropping and tail closure during setup.

Saved the self-contained .blend, reopened with autoexec disabled, audited 360 frames, rendered eight character views and a native Blender H.264 video. Promoted the partial video only after full decode/metadata verification.
Compared source art and actual native model; visually inspected all eight views and 30 sampled video frames. This is not uninterrupted playback or a claim of zero perceptible flicker.
Uploaded the 1,284,994-byte input ZIP to the authorized Colab session. Verified all input hashes and official 383,295,504-byte Blender Linux archive checksum.

First official download returned HTTP 403 using urllib default user-agent. Retried the same URL with a normal User-Agent header successfully; corrected the local starter notebook. No alternative model or paid service.

Rendered three poses from the identical master using actual L4 CUDA. Downloaded result ZIP through browser Save dialog; verified all nine payload records before extraction. Downloaded cloud start/deep-breath images visually reviewed.
Saved the executed notebook in Colab. Local executed-notebook download did not complete; kept corrected unexecuted starter and downloaded execution logs/results separately.

User approved ending this trial. On returning to the tab it was already disconnected; no delete click was needed. UI showed zero active sessions and zero usage per hour. Exact disconnect time/cause were not observed.
Updated current P01 documentation/evidence. No core, CLI or web app code changed; no full app regression run required for this media feasibility checkpoint.
unresolved: Refine and obtain approval of native character likeness before extending this draft; no automatic image reconstruction promised.
Walking, hand/cup contact, true wardrobe changes, cafe/scene reuse, full light/dark motion and 90-second rehearsal remain untested.
App-driven repeatable preparation and fresh-project reuse remain unimplemented; P01 stays open and P02-P04 blocked.
Three grainy cloud diagnostic frames are not a full-video throughput/cost benchmark. Local EEVEE and cloud Cycles are different output configurations.
Local authoring time was not instrumented; code authoring and setup corrections remain real work despite zero specialist user intervention.
Art, underlying rights, music and publication approval remain separate. No music was uploaded or changed.
generation_prompt: No image/model generation prompt. Native Blender authoring brief: study existing TABI illustration and draft turnaround, author a persistent lavender character with six pink gills, coral headphones, green coat and leopard trim, native train scene and continuous exterior motion; bake 15 seconds of breathing, blink, small turn, sway and a larger breath. Label as unapproved feasibility draft and preserve prior artwork.
